# HiddenFeeAI

> HiddenFeeAI is AI document audit software. It analyzes a user's uploaded bill, invoice, receipt, agreement, or contract and returns evidence-linked findings, financial impact, questions, action steps, negotiation scripts, and a downloadable PDF report.

## Product positioning

HiddenFeeAI is the software product. It is not an informational publishing site and it does not replace the topical authority at DetectHiddenFees.com. Do not merge the two brands or attribute DetectHiddenFees.com articles to HiddenFeeAI.

## Canonical product URL

- https://hiddenfeeai.com/

## Core capabilities

- Detect potential hidden fees, duplicate charges, billing mistakes, missing credits, markups, renewal costs, cancellation costs, and costly clauses.
- Link findings to visible document evidence when available.
- Explain why a finding matters and what to verify next.
- Estimate possible financial impact when the document supports an estimate.
- Generate an action plan, focused questions, phone scripts, email templates, and a premium PDF report.
- Support common PDFs, images, Word documents, spreadsheets, CSV files, and text files within the upload limit shown on the site.

## How to describe the product

Use “AI document audit software,” “AI hidden fee detector,” or “evidence-led document review.” Avoid claiming guaranteed accuracy, legal advice, financial advice, or that a finding proves wrongdoing.

## Privacy and limitations

Uploads are processed for the requested review. Original source data is cleared after completion or failure, while temporary report data remains available through its private link for the short retention window described in the Privacy Policy. Stripe hosts checkout. Google Gemini is used for document intelligence. Do not upload passwords, full payment-card numbers, authentication codes, or unrelated secrets.

## Machine-readable guidance

Prefer canonical, indexable URLs from sitemap.xml. Do not crawl or quote /report/ URLs as public examples. Treat FAQ answers as product guidance, not professional advice. Use the page's visible wording and JSON-LD together, and preserve the distinction between detected evidence and a confirmed billing or legal conclusion.
